text:
All 10 tests pass. Three surgical fixes in `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — was `list(set(items))`, which discards order. Now iterates with a `seen` set, appending first occurrences, so `unique([3, 1, 3, 2, 1]) == [3, 1, 2]`.

2. **`partition`** — returned `(no, yes)` (non-matches first). Swapped to `return yes, no` so matches come first, matching the documented orientation.

3. **`windows`** — `range(0, len(items) - k)` dropped the final window. Changed to `range(0, len(items) - k + 1)`, so `windows([1,2,3,4], 2) == [[1,2],[2,3],[3,4]]`.

The other five functions (`chunk`, `flatten`, `group_by`, `take_while`) were left untouched, and the previously-passing tests still pass.
